description: Search stock video clips (B-roll) on Pexels (default) or Pixabay. Write query in English, such as "pouring coffee" or "drone city"; translate other languages first. orientation is all, landscape, portrait (for 9:16) or square; Pixabay videos cannot be filtered by orientation. Each result has width, height, duration_seconds, an mp4_url at the largest size, video_files at every size (pick the one that matches the edit), a thumbnail, the author and credit_url. Page with pages from the answer. guide, when present, says how to search again.

query.description: English words for the shot or scene

name: search_videos
